LibraryStatus.title: Library Status
LibraryStatus.description: Real-time occupancy and capacity data for the library.

occupancy.description: Current number of people in the library.

system_online.description: Whether the monitoring system is online.

ActiveReservation.title: Active Reservation
ActiveReservation.description: A seat reservation made by a student.

is_used.description: Whether the reservation has been fulfilled.

ReportedIssue.title: Reported Issue
ReportedIssue.description: An issue or feedback reported by a student regarding desk accuracy or library facilities.

zone.description: Library zone where the issue occurred.

urgency.description: Urgency level of the issue (low, medium, critical).

reporterEmail.description: Email of the student filing the report.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the report was submitted.

library_status/current.description: The singleton document for current library state.

staff_presence/{staffId}.description: Collection of staff members and their presence.

staff_presence/{staffId}/logs/{logId}.description: Historical log entries for individual staff presence transitions.

staff_presence/{staffId}/portal_logins/{.description: Historical login tracking for staff web portal sessions.

announcements/{announcementId}.description: Collection of announcements published by the library staff.

occupancy_history/{historyId}.description: Collection of library occupancies logged at various timestamp milestones.

reported_issues/{issueId}.description: Collection of facility issues and occupancy feedback reports.
